days.title: Siku ya 1
days.body:
[[invocation]]Kwa Jina la Baba, na la Mwana, na la Roho Mtakatifu.[[/invocation]]

[[plain]]Amina.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]Litania ya Tumaini[[/heading]]

[[plain]]Kutoka imani kwamba ni lazima niustahili upendo wako - Uniokoe, Yesu.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Kutoka hofu kwamba sistahili kupendwa - Uniokoe, Yesu.[[/plain]]
